t: A 10-inch vitrified ironstone pipe sewer be constructed in the center line of Vallejo alley, 5 feet northerly from the southerly end thereof, to connect with the existing brick sewer along the center line of Montgomery avenue.
On recommendation of Lighting, Water and Telephone Service and Electricity Committee.

Jennings, Johnston — A 10-inch vitrified ironstone pipe sewer be constructed in the center line of Yallejo alley, 5 feet northerly from the southerly end thereof, to connect with the existing brick sewer along the center line of Montgomery avenue.
